prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1165; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. The reported injuries are consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Care was delivered over 23 visits, consisting of manual therapy, supervised exercise, and home program instruction, and followed an expected course with symptoms gradually easing and visit frequency tapering as function improved. Most of the clinical picture rests on the patient's subjective pain reports, as cervical and lumbar range-of-motion and neurological screening were unremarkable and imaging studies showed no acute abnormality. The patient mentioned a minor strain to the same region several years ago, which the patient reports resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no duplicated or repeated entries. Prognosis is fair with continued home exercise, and the patient was advised to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
